construct_config_from_yaml: build a python module to load a YAML config file into a yacs CfgNode with command-line overrides
construct_config_for_nav: create a navigation config by loading a YAML file and disabling the gripper camera
construct_config_for_gaze: build a gaze task config that disables head cameras and optionally overrides pick-up and episode step settings
construct_config_for_place: create a place task config by loading a YAML file and disabling both head and gripper cameras
construct_config_for_open_close_drawer: build an open-close-drawer config by loading a YAML file and disabling the head camera
